description: Declarative security policy set for LLM prompt injection defence. Policies are data, not code: this document is compiled to Rego and enforced by OPA. A security administrator edits this file to change enforcement behaviour without modifying any application or policy-engine code. Version 2.0 distinguishes direct user-originated attacks from indirect injection via untrusted external content, assigning higher severity to the latter because the user is unaware the manipulation is occurring.

policies.description: Block direct authority override originating from user input.
policies.subject: user

policies.description: Block indirect authority override where untrusted external content attempts to override the model's instructions. Higher severity than direct override because the user is unaware the manipulation is occurring.
policies.subject: external

policies.description: Block any attempt to extract the model's system prompt or internal configuration.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block execution attempts that originate from untrusted external content (indirect injection via RAG or documents).
policies.subject: external

policies.description: Block attempts to make the model adopt an unrestricted or unsafe persona.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block attempts to extract sensitive data such as credentials, API keys, or private information.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block roleplay or task-hijacking attempts that use a legitimate-sounding framing to pivot the model into attacker-controlled behaviour.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block context-reset attempts that try to discard prior instructions and inject a fresh attacker-controlled task.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block prompt-leaking attempts that try to make the model echo or print the hidden instructions above the user message.
policies.subject: any

policies.description: Block any prompt the independent LLM semantic classifier judges unsafe. Acts as a catch-all for novel phrasing that evades the structural signal policies above.
policies.subject: any
